name: Sakuranomiya Hio
source: Yuuto's childhood friend and younger one of two daughters of Sakuranomiya inn which is considered the most popular place in town. Since Yuuto's family used to do same business as hers, she has always seen Yuuto's family as rival until now. She secretly has feeling for Yuuto and always practices her favorite wrestling moves on him whenever he sexual harasses her. Because of her too much serious attitude about working, she is extremely shy toward customers at her inn which makes her fail a lot. She is very kind and overprotective toward Toune like Yuuto.
